describe: A procedural rig: a creature made of the blocks of engine/anim/proc (it starts as a small four-legged walker: a planted gait on two diagonals, two-bone legs, a body bobbing on a spring, a wagging tail, a looking head) and its rig spec, with a unit test that passes it through rigCheck and walks it on its diagonals (PLAN.md WP 10.1).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/rigs/<name> (its rig's id is rig:<name>; `node x qa anim` drives the fixture rigs, a game's own test drives its own): labs/box/rigs/crab
